source: Summary of observed failed tool/test output in this implementation, followed by successful reruns

cases.outcome: Node installed executable access was damaged by adding a sandbox ACE to a NULL DACL.
cases.resolution: Original access restored with administrator action; version and bytes verified. Guard against NULL DACL rewrites; execute an owned Node copy.

cases.outcome: EPERM lstat D:\ while Node resolved the entry path
cases.resolution: Preserve symlink paths for packages that reject links; real sandbox read/write and sibling denial passed.

cases.outcome: Test expected completed but planning correctly ended in awaiting_input.
cases.resolution: Corrected test expectation; actual draft creation and confirmation remained required.

cases.outcome: Windows could not replace an engine executable still used by a test; a later test saw old code.
cases.resolution: Wait for build completion before running that executable; new model flow passed.

cases.outcome: Exact accessible label lookup timed out although textarea was visible.
cases.resolution: Stable explicit aria-label; actual fill, approve, call and output verification passed.
PyYAML 6.0.3 installed only in the test dependency directory; original validator passed.

cases.outcome: Timed out locating packaged Tauri page after direct cargo build omitted the production protocol.
cases.resolution: Canonical npm run build, hash receipt gate in packager, packaged desktop five checks passed.
